accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments relating to India's institutional framework for non-conventional energy in chronological order:
A. MNRE was renamed from MNES
B. Commission for Additional Sources of Energy was set up
C. Department of Non-Conventional Energy Sources was created
D. A separate Ministry of Non-Conventional Energy Sources was established
accepted.x: CASE was established in 1981, DNES in 1982, MNES in 1992 and the Ministry was renamed MNRE in 2006.
accepted.tq: Use the first and last milestones, then place the intermediate years.
accepted.sec: MNRE - mission, history as FIRST non-conventional energy ministry, attached institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Commission for Additional Sources of Energy (CASE) was set up in:
accepted.x: CASE was set up in 1981 as an early institutional milestone in India's non-conventional energy framework.
accepted.tq: Direct year recall using closely spaced institutional milestones as distractors.
accepted.sec: MNRE - mission, history as FIRST non-conventional energy ministry, attached institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Department of Non-Conventional Energy Sources (DNES) was created in 1982 in the:
accepted.x: DNES was created in 1982 within the Ministry of Energy.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct parent Ministry rather than only the year.
accepted.sec: MNRE - mission, history as FIRST non-conventional energy ministry, attached institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In which year was the Department of Non-Conventional Energy Sources upgraded to a separate Ministry of Non-Conventional Energy Sources?
accepted.x: The Department was upgraded to a separate Ministry of Non-Conventional Energy Sources in 1992.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the creation of a department from its later elevation to a Ministry.
accepted.sec: MNRE - mission, history as FIRST non-conventional energy ministry, attached institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: India became the first country in the world to establish a Ministry specifically for:
accepted.x: India was the first country in the world to set up a ministry for non-conventional energy sources.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of a distinctive international first.
accepted.sec: MNRE - mission, history as FIRST non-conventional energy ministry, attached institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about institutions associated with the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy:
1. NISE is located in Gurugram and serves as a technical focal point for solar research and development.
2. NIWE is located in Chennai and is associated with wind research and the wind roadmap.
3. NIBE is located in Kapurthala and is concerned with bio-energy.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: NISE-Gurugram concerns solar R&D, NIWE-Chennai concerns wind R&D and NIBE-Kapurthala concerns bio-energy.
accepted.tq: Check each institution against its location and specialised field.
accepted.sec: MNRE - mission, history as FIRST non-conventional energy ministry, attached institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: NIBE is an autonomous institution located at Kapurthala in Punjab and is associated with bio-energy. NISE, NIWE and SECI have different roles.
accepted.tq: Start from the institution-field-location pair that is uniquely correct.
accepted.sec: MNRE - mission, history as FIRST non-conventional energy ministry, attached institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which institution functions as a PSU and implementing arm for the National Solar Mission and wind projects?
accepted.x: The Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) is a PSU and serves as the implementing arm for the National Solar Mission and wind projects.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an implementing agency from research and financing institutions.
accepted.sec: MNRE - mission, history as FIRST non-conventional energy ministry, attached institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements is correct regarding IREDA?
o: It is an academic department under IIT Roorkee.
It is an autonomous solar research institution in Gurugram.
It is the nodal agency for the wind roadmap.
It is a PSU and NBFC providing term loans for renewable-energy and energy-efficiency projects.
accepted.x: IREDA is a PSU and non-banking financial company that provides term loans for renewable-energy and energy-efficiency projects.
accepted.tq: Match the institution with its organisational type and core function.
accepted.sec: MNRE - mission, history as FIRST non-conventional energy ministry, attached institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. DHRE, IIT Roorkee provides technical support for small hydro.
2. DHRE is under the administrative control of MNRE.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
accepted.x: DHRE, IIT Roorkee provides technical support for small hydro, but it is not under MNRE's control.
accepted.tq: Test the distinction between technical association and administrative control.
accepted.sec: MNRE - mission, history as FIRST non-conventional energy ministry, attached institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Who publishes the Renewable Energy Country Attractiveness Index (RECAI)?
accepted.x: The Renewable Energy Country Attractiveness Index is published by EY, formerly Ernst & Young.

accepted.s: The report ‘Renewables Integration in India’ released in 2021 was prepared by:

accepted.s: Which of the following reports is published by the International Energy Agency?
accepted.x: The World Energy Outlook and India Energy Outlook are published by the IEA. Renewable Capacity Statistics is published by IRENA, RECAI by EY and Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2025 by IRENA.

accepted.s: According to the July 2026 finding cited for ‘Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2025’, more than what proportion of new utility-scale renewable-energy capacity was cheaper than the cheapest fossil-fuel option?
accepted.x: IRENA reported that more than 90% of new utility-scale renewable-energy capacity was cheaper than the cheapest fossil-fuel alternative.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a high but non-total proportion from the absolute option.

accepted.s: The renewable-energy cost reductions reported for 2025 were stated to have avoided approximately what fossil-fuel cost?

accepted.s: Which one of the following sets correctly represents India's positions in the cited renewable-energy indicators?
o: Second in total renewable capacity, fourth in wind, and third-largest solar-growth market in 2025
Fourth in total renewable capacity, third in wind, and largest solar-growth market in 2025
Third in total renewable capacity, fourth in wind, and second-largest solar-growth market in 2025
Third in total renewable capacity, second in wind, and fourth-largest solar-growth market in 2025
accepted.x: The cited findings place India third in total renewable-energy capacity, fourth in wind and as the second-largest solar-growth market in 2025.
accepted.tq: Keep the three rank indicators together and reject reversed comparisons.

accepted.s: India overtook which country to become the third-largest solar power producer?
accepted.x: India overtook Japan and became the third-largest solar power producer according to the cited August 2026 finding.

accepted.s: The National Clean Energy Fund was created in 2010–11 primarily from a cess imposed on:
accepted.x: The NCEF was created in 2010–11 from a clean-energy cess on domestic and imported coal.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct revenue source rather than the fund's purpose.

accepted.s: The initial clean-energy cess associated with the National Clean Energy Fund was:
accepted.x: The initial cess was ₹50 per tonne on both domestic and imported coal.
accepted.tq: Test the exact levy amount with adjacent numerical distractors.
accepted.sec: National Clean Energy Fund (NCEF) - funding, purpose, status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following best describes the purpose of the National Clean Energy Fund?
o: To regulate electricity tariffs in States
To provide free electricity to all households
To finance research and innovative projects in clean-energy technologies
accepted.x: The NCEF was intended to fund research and innovative projects in clean-energy technologies, promote renewable technologies and reduce carbon emissions.
accepted.tq: Match the fund with its functional purpose, not a general energy-sector activity.
accepted.sec: National Clean Energy Fund (NCEF) - funding, purpose, status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which development ended the dedicated inflow to the National Clean Energy Fund?
o: The conversion of MNRE into MNES
The subsuming of the coal cess into the GST Compensation Cess in July 2017
The replacement of coal by natural gas
accepted.x: The coal cess was subsumed into the GST Compensation Cess in July 2017, thereby ending the NCEF's dedicated inflow.
accepted.tq: Link the fund's status to the specific fiscal change and date.
accepted.sec: National Clean Energy Fund (NCEF) - funding, purpose, status  [APPSC]
